about: Cases for `page { .. }`, the skip link and `Header { sticky: true }` (docs/page.md). A case is a `page` text and a `view`, or a whole `program`. The files are written beside the program.
view: Header { sticky: true Link { to: "#top" "home" } Nav { label: "Sections" Link { to: "#try" "Try it" } } } Main { id: "main" Section { label: "Top" id: "top" Text { "x" } } Section { label: "Try" id: "try" Text { "y" } } }
